title: Suggestions board — choose a path before anything is implemented
how_to_read: Nothing on this board has been implemented. Each row states the problem, the proposal, impact, effort, risk, prerequisites and current status. A reviewer picks the best path; implementation happens only after that choice.

rows.title: Ingest a licensed odds feed (closing lines)
rows.problem: S1-S4 and gate G6 cannot be evaluated without market prices (Q1, Q18).
rows.proposal: Procure rights-cleared closing lines for 2026 weeks 11-18 and future seasons; store with capture timestamps.

rows.title: Extract player stats from official game books
rows.problem: Player-prop combos (S5/S6) and prop correlations are blocked (Q2).
rows.proposal: Parse the per-game official game-book PDFs (linked from every nfl.com game page) into a player-outcomes table.

rows.title: Derive snap-count depth tiers
rows.problem: '2nd/3rd/4th string' designation is unverifiable from any league page (Q3, Q16).
rows.proposal: Derive empirical usage tiers (starter = majority snaps) from game books; keep official-news starter names as the authoritative overlay.

rows.title: Pre-register an injury-adjustment model
rows.problem: Lines currently ignore injuries even though 14 Out statuses exist (Q4).
rows.proposal: Before Week 12, register a fixed injury-value model (e.g., positional replacement deltas), then test walk-forward on weeks 12-18.

rows.title: Weekly automated capture job
rows.problem: Data freshness depends on agent sessions (Q14).
rows.proposal: A scheduled workflow re-fetches standings, slate, injuries each Friday; snapshot diffs land in data/ with timestamps.

rows.title: Freeze model v1 and grade weeks 11-18 forward
rows.problem: Holdout too small to separate skill from luck (Q8).
rows.proposal: Freeze this model exactly as committed; grade every week forward with the same gates; no tuning.

rows.title: Extend verified archive to 2024-2025
rows.problem: Gate G2 (>=300 graded selections) cannot be met on 2026 alone (Q7).
rows.proposal: Capture official week pages for 2024-2025 and reconcile the same way as 2026 (aggregate + spot checks).

rows.title: Verify the 6 disputed neutral-site games
rows.problem: Peer archive flags 6 games neutral without official confirmation (Q19, F-06).
rows.proposal: Fetch the 6 official game pages; record venue; correct flags.

rows.title: Decide the reward structure
rows.proposal: Choose: (a) points only, (b) funded prizes with rules, (c) recognition badges. Record decision here before any leaderboard payout.

rows.title: QB-status feature for the totals model
rows.problem: Totals model slightly worse than naive (Q11).
rows.proposal: Pre-register QB availability features (from official news) before Week 12 and test forward.

rows.title: Legal review of NFL data terms
rows.proposal: Read nfl.com terms of service; record clauses governing stats/scraping/republication.

rows.title: Choose one canonical NFL dashboard
rows.problem: 12 overlapping NFL workspaces confuse readers (Q20, F-13).
rows.proposal: Reviewer picks an entry hub (this workspace, nfl-edge, or a new index page); others remain as archives with a banner.

rows.title: Closing-line-value tracker
rows.problem: Cannot tell if our lines are sharp (Q18).
rows.proposal: Once SUG-01 exists, log our line at publication and compare with kick-off close on every game.

rows.title: Weather inputs for totals
rows.proposal: Add forecast wind/temperature from official stadium reports when available; pre-register before use.

rows.title: Publish weekly decision digest
rows.problem: Reviewers need a recurring decision point.
rows.proposal: Each Friday, auto-generate a digest: new injuries, changed starter statuses, own lines vs prior, open questions.

rows.title: Keep the no-fabrication verifier permanent
rows.problem: Row-level sourcing can regress over time.
rows.proposal: Keep engine/verify_site.py as a required CI gate on every future change to this workspace.
